ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the contour map and precipitation seasonal distribution bar chart of a small island in the central Pacific. <image1> Among the four locations ①—④ in the figure, if one wants to take a photo with the island's main peak as the background, which location is the most suitable?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the left figure is a contour map of a small island, with a contour interval of 25 meters, and there are four candidate locations ①②③④ on the island; ① is located in the southwestern part of the island, relatively close to the western mountainous area, ③ is near the mountainous area in the northwest, ② is on the eastern edge of the island, and ④ is in a position slightly central in the southern part of the island, lower and relatively open. The main peak in the figure can be judged from the highland where closed contours are relatively concentrated in the area slightly east of the middle of the island. The right figure is a precipitation seasonal distribution bar chart; the selection of the photographing location in this question is mainly based on the contour map on the left. Then reason: to take a photo "with the main peak as the background," the location should be at a lower place in front of the main peak, keep a certain distance from the main peak, and have a relatively open view, making it convenient to include the main peak completely in the background. ① and ③ are close to the western mountainous area or ridge, and are easily blocked by terrain or have a poor angle; ② is on the eastern edge, and its distance and viewing angle are not as open as the southern side; ④ is located at a lower place in front of the southern side of the main peak, has an appropriate distance from the main peak, and is relatively suitable as a location for photographing the main peak background. Therefore the most suitable is ④.

raw_record.question_text:
Read the contour map and precipitation seasonal distribution bar chart of a small island in the central Pacific.

<image1>

Among the four locations ①—④ in the figure, if one wants to take a photo with the island's main peak as the background, which location is the most suitable?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：左图为小岛等高线图，四个候选点分布在岛的西南、东北、西北和南部；主峰可由岛中部偏东的闭合等高线高地确定。再推理：比较①、②、③、④与主峰的空间关系，①和③靠近西侧山地或山脊，②在东侧边缘且视角不如南侧开阔，④位于主峰前方较低处，与主峰保持适当距离，能够把主峰完整纳入背景。因此选择④。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：左图是小岛等高线图，等高距为25米，岛上有①②③④四个候选地点；①位于岛的西南部较靠近西侧山地，③在西北部山地附近，②在岛的东侧边缘，④在岛南部偏中、较低且相对开阔的位置。图中主峰可由岛中部偏东一带闭合等高线较集中的高地来判断。右图是降水季节分配柱状图，本题选择拍摄地点主要依据左侧等高线图。
再推理：要拍摄“以主峰为背景”的照片，地点应位于主峰前方较低处，并与主峰保持一定距离，视野较开阔，便于把主峰完整纳入背景。①和③靠近西侧山地或山脊，容易受地形遮挡或角度不佳；②在东侧边缘，距离和视角不如南侧开阔；④位于主峰南侧前方的较低处，与主峰有适当距离，较适合作为拍摄主峰背景的位置。因此最合适的是④。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 采用直接判读等高线与拍摄视线关系的路线：先找主峰，再判断四个点相对主峰的位置和是否适合作为前景机位。题目本身基本只有这一条核心解法，因此该方法为主要且充分的解法。
planner_metadata.image_role: 从左侧等高线图读取岛屿轮廓、指北针、等高线闭合圈和①—④的位置；重点识别主峰位于岛屿中部偏东、由多条闭合等高线围绕的高地附近，并观察④位于主峰南侧或西南侧的较低处，面向主峰视野较开阔。右侧降水柱状图对此小问基本不参与判断。
planner_metadata.text_role: 读取题干要求：在①—④四处地点中选择一个最适合拍摄“以该岛主峰为背景”的地点，答案需给出地点编号。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 等高线闭合且向内海拔升高表示山峰，闭合圈层数多、位置居中的最高高地可判为主峰；拍摄“以主峰为背景”的照片，应选择位于主峰前方、海拔较低、与主峰有一定距离且视线不易被其他山脊遮挡的地点，而不是在峰顶附近、背后或被山脊阻隔的位置。
